title: Age-stratified individual-specific subspace of autism spectrum disorder based on common orthogonal basis extraction algorithm improves the accuracy of clinical symptoms prediction.
abstract: 437 participants (208 ASD, 229 TD) from ABIDE. Common orthogonal basis extraction (COBE) isolated age-stratified individual-specific functional connectivity features, improving behavioral symptom prediction (peak +133% for adolescent social behavior), replicated in an independent sample.
